question.text: Godavari VC AIF (PIC INR 50 cr). End-of-year Net AUM: Y1 56.42, Y2 63.30, Y3 75.09, Y4 87.86 (all INR cr), zero distributions till Y4. In Y5, distribution of INR 102.62 cr and AUM = 0. TVPI at Y4 is closest to:

explanation.text: The Logic: At Y4: RVPI = 87.86 / 50 = 1.7572 ≈ 1.76. DPI at Y4 = 0 (no distributions yet). TVPI = DPI + RVPI = 0 + 1.76 = 1.76. Matches PDF Example 7.2 best-case. The Trap: 1.13 is Y1 RVPI (56.42/50). 1.50 is Y3 RVPI. 2.05 is Y5 DPI (post-distribution). Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C, XIX-A test the identical decomposition. Cambridge Associates uses quarterly TVPI snapshots. Manager's Pro-Tip: Report TVPI every half-year even if DPI = 0 — investors care about RVPI trajectory as a leading indicator of future DPI.
